rv.q: And that is the triumph of 'Remember This.'
Though this is a difficult play to watch, the story, the script, the design elements, and Strathairn's inspired performance make it impossible to look away.
To this writer, the results are as transformative as the physical production.
Remember This: The Lesson of Jan Karski is a truly remarkable story of the power of a single person, and is a lesson for all of us about perseverance in the face of history and fate.
'Remember This' is smartly crafted political theater, its message stark and compelling, though the outcome is known before the play begins.
If there is any one production that you should see this fall, this is the one. Its brilliance and substance will make a lasting impression on you.
Coming out of it I was incredibly appreciative of this production.
